tasks.description: Actively recall yesterday's top concepts in writing without looking at notes.

tasks.description: Re-read your most recent mistake log entries and identify repeated error classes.

tasks.title: Formula sheet / short notes revise karo (20 min)
tasks.description: Revise formulas and short notes of recently studied chapters.

tasks.title: Ek adhoora task close karo (15 min)
tasks.description: Pick one incomplete task from your backlog and finish it in a focused 15-minute sprint.

tasks.title: Backlog cleanup: top-3 pending items list karo aur ek chuno (10 min)
tasks.description: List the three most important pending items and pick one to clear today.

tasks.title: Re-entry: aaj ke liye sirf 2 core habits chuno (5 min)
tasks.description: After a missed streak, pick just two core habits to restart gently instead of everything.

tasks.title: Gap review: kya hua aur kal ka chhota plan (10 min)
tasks.description: Reflect on why days were missed and write a small, realistic plan for tomorrow.

tasks.title: Weak habit rescue: 10-min focused session on weakest habit
tasks.description: A short, low-pressure session targeting the habit with the lowest recent score.

tasks.title: Evidence reset: pichhle 3 din ke 2 proofs likho (10 min)
tasks.description: Streak tootne par apne kaam ke 2 concrete proofs likho — mindset wapas evidence-based track pe aa jaata hai.

tasks.title: System restart: ek recurring miss ka 5-Why (10 min)
tasks.description: Ek baar ka miss koi baat nahi — pattern hai toh system ka issue. Ek recurring miss uthao aur 5-Why lagao.

tasks.title: Execution re-entry: top-1 priority chuno + 25-min block (15 min)
tasks.description: Sab kuch ek saath nahi — aaj sirf ek highest-impact task chuno aur ek focused block laga do.

tasks.title: Fast restart: slip ke baad ek chhota win (10 min)
tasks.description: Slip hone par 10-min ka ek achievable task karo — momentum chhote win se wapas aata hai.

tasks.title: Recovery protocol: 5-min energy audit + sleep plan (10 min)
tasks.description: Energy kahan gaya? Aaj ki audit karo aur kal ki neend ka plan lock karo.

tasks.title: Pressure reset: 2-min breathing + ek realistic mini-goal (10 min)
tasks.description: Pressure ko label karo, breathing se reset karo, aur ek achievable mini-goal set karo — poora system wapas chalne do.

tasks.title: Evidence check: claim → proof → gap
tasks.description: Pick one weak concept/test mistake and write claim, evidence, and missing proof before studying.

tasks.title: Assumption test on one JEE problem
tasks.description: Before solving, list two assumptions and verify them after solution.

tasks.title: Reality review: score vs effort
tasks.description: Compare planned vs actual study output and write one correction for tomorrow.

tasks.title: Hypothesis drill for a tough concept
tasks.description: Make one why/how hypothesis, test it with notes or solved examples, and record result.

tasks.title: Find one counterexample
tasks.description: For a formula/rule, find where it fails or what condition is required.

tasks.title: Assumption log update
tasks.description: Log one wrong assumption from today and the corrected version.

tasks.title: 5-Why root cause on one mistake
tasks.description: Use five-whys on one repeated mistake until the real cause is specific.

tasks.title: One system fix for a recurring miss
tasks.description: Create a small checklist/process change that prevents a repeated error.

tasks.title: Feedback loop close-out
tasks.description: Review yesterday’s fix and mark whether it reduced the problem.

tasks.title: Derive from first principles
tasks.description: Derive one formula/result from definitions instead of memorising it.

tasks.title: Probability estimate before answer
tasks.description: Estimate answer range/sign before calculation and compare after solving.

tasks.title: Principle map for a chapter
tasks.description: Map one chapter topic to its core laws and common question patterns.

tasks.title: Bias check before judging performance
tasks.description: Separate facts from feelings about today’s performance in three bullets.

tasks.title: Independent solution attempt
tasks.description: Try one problem fully before looking at hints/solution.

tasks.title: Objective review of a wrong answer
tasks.description: Write what data says went wrong: concept, calculation, interpretation, or time.

tasks.title: One deep why question
tasks.description: Ask and answer one deeper why behind a concept connection.

tasks.title: Link two topics
tasks.description: Connect two related ideas across chapters/subjects with an example.

tasks.title: Knowledge gap capture
tasks.description: Write one gap discovered today and the exact source/action to close it.

tasks.title: Attention reset before study block
tasks.description: Do a 60-second reset: desk clear, phone away, target visible.

tasks.title: Question condition scan
tasks.description: Underline/list every condition in three problems before solving.

tasks.title: Vigilance review
tasks.description: Record one missed condition/sign/unit and prevention cue.

tasks.title: Precision checklist run
tasks.description: Run units/signs/boundary checks on today’s toughest solved problem.

tasks.title: Adapt plan from evidence
tasks.description: Change one plan item based on latest performance evidence.

tasks.title: Decision log: what to skip/keep
tasks.description: Write one keep/skip decision for tomorrow with reason.

tasks.title: Best/base/worst study scenario
tasks.description: Plan today with best/base/worst-case time blocks.

tasks.title: Add buffer for biggest risk
tasks.description: Identify biggest schedule risk and add a backup slot.

tasks.title: Scenario review at night
tasks.description: Check which scenario happened and what to adjust.

tasks.title: Rank tasks by marks impact
tasks.description: Rank today’s tasks by JEE marks impact, not comfort.

tasks.title: Do highest-impact task first
tasks.description: Start with the highest-impact task for at least 25 minutes.

tasks.title: Cut one low-value activity
tasks.description: Remove or shrink one low-value task/distraction today.

tasks.title: Prepare study resources upfront
tasks.description: Keep notes, PYQs, timer, and formula sheet ready before block.

tasks.title: Clean one topic folder/list
tasks.description: Organise one chapter’s pending questions/resources into clear buckets.

tasks.title: Resource review
tasks.description: Note one missing resource and when you will collect it.

tasks.title: Explain one concept aloud
tasks.description: Teach one concept aloud in simple language without notes.

tasks.title: Confidence rep: timed answer
tasks.description: Solve one timed question and write what improved confidence.

tasks.title: Write one precise doubt
tasks.description: Frame one doubt with context, attempt, and exact stuck point.

tasks.title: Finish a resistance block
tasks.description: Do 20 minutes on the task you most want to avoid.

tasks.title: Commitment check
tasks.description: Write why this goal matters and one promise for the next block.

tasks.title: Restart fast after slip
tasks.description: If distracted, restart within 2 minutes and log the trigger.

tasks.title: Reframe one weakness as trainable
tasks.description: Turn one weak area into a concrete practice plan.

tasks.title: Self-evaluate today honestly
tasks.description: Score focus, accuracy, and consistency with one reason each.

tasks.title: One improvement rep
tasks.description: Repeat one previously wrong question/concept and verify improvement.

tasks.title: Label stress before reacting
tasks.description: Name the emotion, trigger, and next best action before study.

tasks.title: Two-minute breathing reset
tasks.description: Do a calm reset before a mock/revision block.

tasks.title: Pressure review
tasks.description: Write how stress affected decisions and one correction.

tasks.title: Sleep plan lock
tasks.description: Set bedtime/wakeup and shutdown study 30 minutes before sleep.

tasks.title: Recovery walk/stretch
tasks.description: Do 10 minutes walk/stretch to protect energy.

tasks.title: Energy review
tasks.description: Rate sleep/energy and adjust tomorrow’s load.

tasks.title: Exam-day protocol rehearsal
tasks.description: Rehearse admit-card/material/time/checklist mentally and log gaps.

tasks.title: Final revision only
tasks.description: Revise formulae/mistake log; avoid new topics unless critical.

tasks.title: Lifelong system reflection
tasks.description: Write the 3 systems you will keep after this 90-day cycle.
